name: Examination
definition: 由医疗机构对就诊者实施、以一组实验室检测项目与症状描述为内容并形成诊断结论的一次医学检查信息记录。 Counterexample: 与 Laboratory 的区别：Laboratory 记录的是生化与血液学检验数值，Examination 记录的是抗磷脂抗体、ANA、KCT、RVVT、LAC 等免疫与凝血相关检查及诊断结论。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Examination; provenance: direct source Examination

name: Laboratory
definition: 在某一日期对就诊者样本完成、以多项生化与血液学指标测定值为内容的一次实验室检验信息记录。 Counterexample: 与 Examination 的区别：Examination 侧重免疫、凝血与症状诊断信息，Laboratory 侧重肝肾功能、血脂、血细胞计数等定量检验指标。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Laboratory; provenance: direct source Laboratory

name: Patient
definition: 在医疗机构接受检查、检验与诊疗服务的自然人。 Counterexample: 与 Examination、Laboratory 的区别：后两者是围绕患者产生的信息记录，患者本身是接受医疗服务的自然人实体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Patient; provenance: direct source Patient

name: Albumin
definition: Serum albumin concentration measured in the laboratory.

name: PlateletCount
definition: Platelet count from the laboratory panel.

name: GPT
definition: Alanine aminotransferase (GPT) enzyme level.

name: Glucose
definition: Blood glucose concentration.

name: TotalCholesterol
definition: Total serum cholesterol level.

name: IgM
definition: Serum immunoglobulin M level.

name: CreatininePhosphokinase
definition: Creatine phosphokinase enzyme level.

name: CRP
definition: C-reactive protein level or positivity.

name: Creatinine
definition: Serum creatinine concentration.

name: UreaNitrogen
definition: Blood urea nitrogen level.

name: IgG
definition: Serum immunoglobulin G level.

name: AntiCardiolipinIgM
definition: Anti-cardiolipin antibody of IgM isotype.

name: CoagulationPositive
definition: Any positive coagulation test among KCT, RVVT, or LAC.
scope: Examination where KCT = '+' OR RVVT = '+' OR LAC = '+'
aliases: positive measure of degree of coagulation

name: RVVT
definition: Russell viper venom time test result.

name: ThrombosisLevel2
definition: Thrombosis graded as level 2.

name: AntiCentromere
definition: Anti-centromere antibody result.

name: AntiSSB
definition: Anti-SSB antibody result.

name: AntiScl70
definition: Anti-Scl-70 antibody result.

name: Symptoms
definition: Recorded clinical symptoms for the examination.

name: Diagnosis
definition: Clinical diagnosis assigned to the patient.

name: Sex
definition: Patient biological sex.

name: Age
definition: Patient age derived from Birthday.

name: Admission
definition: Whether the patient is admitted (in-patient) or not (out-patient).

name: Description
definition: Free-text description field for the patient.

name: ExaminationDate
definition: Date on which the examination or laboratory test was performed.

name: AverageAlbumin
definition: Mean serum albumin across selected tests. Formula: AVG(Albumin). Inputs: Albumin = Laboratory.ALB

name: AbnormalIgM
definition: IgM outside the normal range (<=40 or >=400). Formula: CASE WHEN IgM <= 40 OR IgM >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: IgM = Laboratory.IGM

name: AbnormalCRP
definition: CRP recorded as positive. Formula: CASE WHEN CRP = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: CRP = Laboratory.CRP

name: AbnormalCreatinine
definition: Creatinine at or above 1.5. Formula: CASE WHEN Creatinine >= 1.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: Creatinine = Laboratory.CRE

name: HighCholesterol
definition: Total cholesterol at or above 250. Formula: CASE WHEN TotalCholesterol >= 250 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: TotalCholesterol = Laboratory.T-CHO

name: NormalIgG
definition: IgG strictly between 900 and 2000. Formula: CASE WHEN IgG > 900 AND IgG < 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: IgG = Laboratory.IGG

name: NormalCPK
definition: CPK below 250. Formula: CASE WHEN CreatininePhosphokinase < 250 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: CreatininePhosphokinase = Laboratory.CPK

name: NormalAntiCentromere
definition: Anti-centromere result in ('-', '+-'). Formula: CASE WHEN AntiCentromere IN ('-', '+-') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: AntiCentromere = Laboratory.CENTROMEA

name: NormalAntiSSB
definition: Anti-SSB result in ('-', '+-'). Formula: CASE WHEN AntiSSB IN ('-', '+-') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: AntiSSB = Laboratory.SSB

name: NormalAntiScl70
definition: Anti-Scl-70 result in ('negative', '0'). Formula: CASE WHEN AntiScl70 IN ('negative', '0') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: AntiScl70 = Laboratory.SC170

name: InpatientMaleRatio
definition: Share of male patients who are in-patients. Formula: COUNT(ID WHERE Sex='M' AND Admission='+') / COUNT(ID WHERE Sex='M'). Inputs: Sex = Patient.SEX; Admission = Patient.Admission

name: CoagulationStatus
definition: Coagulation test positivity across KCT, RVVT, and LAC.

name: ThrombosisGrade
definition: Graded thrombosis status.

name: AdmissionStatus
definition: Whether the patient is admitted or outpatient.

name: SexCategory
definition: Patient sex category.

name: DiagnosisCategory
definition: Clinical diagnosis categories.
